note: Three made-up opportunities so the board can be built before data/synthesis/opportunities.json exists. Hours and costs come from data/teams.json; % removed, confidence and time to value are sample assumptions, not findings.

opportunities.name: Policy and CAO answer desk
opportunities.one_liner: Managers and employees get a sourced answer to leave, allowance and contract questions in minutes; HR approves before it is sent.
opportunities.work_activity: Interpret and explain policies, contracts and regulations

quality.name: Wrong answers on allowances or leave
quality.formula: questions per year × error rate × cost per error × % prevented
quality.note: to measure (E4): no number until Noordhaven logs it

business_case.route_to_cash: No hire is avoided at this size. The hours go to the retention plan per site (the HR North Star); tier-one questions move from HRBPs to HR Administrators.

labour.source: hours and cost from data/teams.json; % removed is a sample assumption

opportunities.value_stream_step: Questions during employment: leave, allowances, contract terms

evidence.claim: Drafting answers from a fixed set of policy documents, with the source quoted, is within what current models do well.

build_brief.summary: A Teams and mail intake that classifies the question, finds the person in AFAS, picks the right CAO (transport or warehouse), drafts an answer that quotes the article, and waits for an HR approval.
scope: Leave, overtime, shift allowance and notice questions
Answers in Dutch, English and Polish
Approved answers become a reusable library
not_in_scope: Conflicts, dismissals and health details: these route straight to an HRBP

golden_demo.event_trigger: A shift lead in Venlo asks in Teams late in the evening whether the night allowance applies to a worker who moved from an agency to a fixed contract mid-month.
golden_demo.messy_case: Two CAOs apply to one month, the employee number in the message has a typo, and the question mixes Dutch and English.
golden_demo.real_artefact: A draft answer that quotes the warehouse CAO article on SharePoint and the contract start date in AFAS Profit.
golden_demo.approval_gate: An HR Administrator approves or edits the draft in Teams; anything about pay is copied to Payroll.
golden_demo.closes_the_loop: The answer is sent, logged on the employee file in AFAS, and added to the approved-answers library.
golden_demo.business_number: The case list shows this week’s answers, the median time to answer and the hours returned.

tasks.statement: Interpret and explain human resources policies, procedures, laws, standards, or regulations.
Answer questions regarding examinations, eligibility, salaries, benefits, and other pertinent information.
Examine employee files to answer inquiries and provide information for personnel actions.

opportunities.name: Supplier invoice to booking
opportunities.one_liner: Invoices arrive as PDF or agency CSV; they are read, matched to the order and coded, and only the exceptions reach a bookkeeper.
opportunities.work_activity: Code, match and check financial documents

financial.name: Early-payment discounts captured
financial.formula: invoices with a discount × average discount × share now paid in time
financial.note: to measure (E4): no number until Noordhaven logs it

quality.name: Duplicate or mis-coded invoices
quality.formula: invoices per year × error rate × cost per error × % prevented
quality.note: to measure (E4): no number until Noordhaven logs it

business_case.route_to_cash: Seasonal flex peaks are absorbed without temporary bookkeeping help; one bookkeeper moves to supplier queries and the month close.

labour.source: hours and cost from data/teams.json; % removed is a sample assumption

opportunities.value_stream_step: Invoice received to invoice booked and routed for approval

evidence.claim: Reading invoice PDFs into structured fields is a mature product category.

build_brief.summary: A deterministic workflow with one model call: read the invoice, match it to the order or the agency hours export, propose the coding, post matched invoices, queue the rest.
scope: PDF and e-invoice intake from the AP inbox
Match against orders and agency CSV hours
Coding proposal with cost centre per site
not_in_scope: Payment runs: they stay in the existing Rabobank batch flow

golden_demo.event_trigger: A PDF invoice from a staffing agency lands in the accounts payable inbox.
golden_demo.messy_case: The invoice covers two sites, one line has no order, and one hourly rate differs from the contract.
golden_demo.real_artefact: A draft booking in AFAS Profit with a cost centre per site, matched line by line to the agency’s CSV export.
golden_demo.approval_gate: The bookkeeper sees only the unmatched line and the rate difference, and approves or queries them.
golden_demo.closes_the_loop: Matched lines are posted, the agency gets a query on the open line by mail, and the case closes when the credit note arrives.
golden_demo.business_number: Share of this month’s invoices processed without touch, and the hours returned.

tasks.statement: Code documents according to company procedures.
Match order forms with invoices, and record the necessary information.
Check figures, postings, and documents for correct entry, mathematical accuracy, and proper codes.

opportunities.name: Overdue account follow-up
opportunities.one_liner: Every overdue invoice gets a timely, account-specific reminder; the officer handles disputes and the large accounts.
opportunities.work_activity: Monitor overdue accounts and contact customers

financial.name: Faster cash
financial.formula: DSO days reduced × average daily revenue × cost of capital
financial.note: to measure (E4): no number until Noordhaven logs it

business_case.route_to_cash: Lower DSO frees working capital; the officer’s hours move to disputes and the largest accounts.

labour.source: hours and cost from data/teams.json; % removed is a sample assumption

evidence.claim: Drafting payment reminders from account history is a routine language task; the risk is tone and wrong amounts.

build_brief.summary: An agent that reads the overdue list and today’s bank statement each morning, drafts the next step per account, and sends after approval.
scope: Payments matched from the CAMT.053 statement
Reminder drafts with the account history
not_in_scope: Handing accounts to a collection agency or lawyer: always a person

golden_demo.event_trigger: The morning CAMT.053 statement is loaded and an invoice passes 30 days overdue.
golden_demo.messy_case: The customer paid part of it with a different reference and has an open complaint about a damaged pallet.
golden_demo.real_artefact: A reminder draft in Outlook that names the open amount after the part payment and parks the disputed line.
golden_demo.approval_gate: The collections officer approves each reminder before it is sent; disputes go to the account manager.
golden_demo.closes_the_loop: The contact is logged in AFAS, a follow-up date is set, and the case closes when the payment is matched.
golden_demo.business_number: Overdue balance and DSO this month against last month.

tasks.statement: Locate and monitor overdue accounts, using computers and a variety of automated systems.
Locate and notify customers of delinquent accounts by mail, telephone, or personal visits to solicit payment.
Record information about financial status of customers and status of collection efforts.
